newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures close narrowly mixed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures close narrowly mixed.

text.p: Singapore rubber futures closed narrowly mixed on Monday in moderate trade amid continued uncertainty over regional currency levels, brokers said.
Tokyo and Kobe prices were mostly lower as the yen's recovery against the (U.S.) dollar pressured the market, but there was no follow-through selling interest here, they said.

"The morning session was quiet and featureless due mainly to the absence of fresh incentives and most people were reluctant to open or hold new positions. But prices turned mixed in the afternoon amid uncertainty over the near-term direction of the currency market. Volume was moderate," a local dealer said.
At around 0945 GMT, April/June RSS3 rose 0.25 cents to 102.25 U.S. cents a kg.
April/June RSS1 was unchanged from last Friday's settlement of 155.25 Singapore cents (US$1.03) a kg.
September TSR20 Award eased half a cent to 142.50 Singapore cents (94 US cents) a kg.
November TSR20 FOB also eased half a cent to 93.50 U.S. cents a kg.
